label: Bible Study
prompt: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no _____; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
verse: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
note: Three men thrown into the furnace, four men walking around in it — and not even the smell of smoke on them afterward.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: (For the LORD thy God is a _____ God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verse: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
note: Moses's guarantee for the far future: a merciful God will not forsake thee or forget His covenant.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a _____ east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verse: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
note: First the gourd withered, then a vehement east wind and a beating sun — and Jonah asked to die over it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In your _____ possess ye your souls.
verse: In your patience possess ye your souls.
note: Jesus' counsel amid predicted wars and betrayals: you keep your soul by enduring, not by escaping.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The _____ of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verse: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
note: Keep the true fast and you shall be called 'The repairer of the breach' — a rebuilder of broken walls and paths.
